text.tspan: The following is a block diagram of the LCD Controller:
The Atari STBook Bit-Block Transfer Processor (BLiTTER) is a hardware implementation of
the bit-block transfer (BitBlt aka blit) algorithm. Bit Blt can be simply described as a procedure
that moves bit-aligned data from a source location to a destination location through a given logic
operation. The BitBlt primitive can be used to perform such operations as:
• Brush line drawing using Bresenham DDA
• Text transformations eg bold, italic, outline
